en: The text describes the gel change as occurring “after 30 days,” whereas neighboring plotted observations are approximately at days 28 and 42. “Changes accelerated after about a month” is more defensible than identifying day 30 as an exact failure date.
The faster change falls between the plotted observations at approximately days 28 and 42—about a month into storage.
The task is not to give two instruments a majority vote over a third. It is to identify what each measurement can reveal under its actual test conditions.
Interpreting each result in light of its sample preparation and measurement target helps determine the next investigation.
zh: 正文把凝胶变化描述为“30天后”，图中的相邻观测点约在第28和42天，因而更合适的说法是“约一个月后变化加快”，而不是认定第30天就是失稳发生日。
凝胶变化加快的区间位于图中约第28至42天之间，即储存约一个月后。
这不是用两票对一票选一个结果，而是承认三项测试的测量条件和敏感对象不同。
结合各项测试的前处理和响应对象，才能解释这些变化并确定下一步排查方向。
